title: ci: @object-ui/app-shell type-check runs at the 4096 MB heap limit, so a cache-missing merge-queue build can die of OOM (exit 134) with no type error
body:
domain:server#4 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWRcTEB3toGxnWvuvX

Filing gate: ③ CI defect met while landing PR #32788 (out-of-scope finding of its card thread). class: b · type: CI · Suggested-grade: p2 · lane: triage to confirm (`ui/packages/app-shell` script, CI infra).

## What happened

The merge-queue build 43282368068 for PR #32788 failed `Type Check UI` (job 131407831770) with no type error:

```
Mark-Compact 4036.4 (4130.1) -> 4020.7 (4130.3) MB ... allocation failure; scavenge might not succeed
FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory
@object-ui/app-shell#type-check: ERROR ... pnpm run type-check exited (134)
```

`ui/packages/app-shell/package.json` `type-check` runs `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 tsc --noEmit && ... tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. The live heap after compaction is about 4020 MB of a 4096 MB limit.

The PR is not the cause: app-shell reads `@object-ui/auth` through its emitted `.d.ts`, and the card thread compared the 55 declaration files of `main` and of the PR byte by byte (identical; the PR only changes the form's internal state). The previous queue build 43282271901 (PR #32789) ran the same app-shell type-check cache-missed and passed, and so did the PR's own CI on head `03979ba6`. So any PR that makes this task miss the turbo cache can hit the limit at random in the queue.

## Expected

The app-shell type-check has headroom: raise its `--max-old-space-size` (the same class as `packages/spec` `check:test-typecheck`, which needs 8192), or split the program so neither `tsc` run sits at the limit. Measure peak heap before and after on a cache-missed run and state it in the PR.

Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue` for `"Type Check UI" heap`, `app-shell type-check heap`, `app-shell "out of memory"`, `type-check OOM ui` → no open card on this.
